entries.subject: Measured occultation silhouette with assumed depth
entries.finding: The measured silhouette anchors the smooth assumed-depth model, without crater or limb-feature extrusion.

entries.subject: Thermal-size comparison and oblate interpretation
entries.finding: The [same study’s thermal-size comparison and preference for an oblate interpretation](https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202346892) is context only. Thermal size is not substituted for the directly observed outline; the pole and true flattening remain undetermined.
